title: Latvia chairs emergency UN meeting on Ukraine
summary_full: On 9th November 2026, Minister of Foreign Affairs Baiba Braže will be in the New York (USA) to take part in an emergency meeting of the UN Security Council (UNSC) on the subject of Ukraine.
